messages:
maria: Heads-up — running a short doc cleanup pass tonight. Found a couple of dead anchors and a param rename that's popping in previews. Posting details here.

docs-bot: preview-build failed for branch docs/rename-pinparam — see https://ci.internal/build/1248 :x:

ajay: I can take the param rename. Which files?

maria: The main culprit is `pin_model` -> `model_id`. Affects /docs/runtime/guides/cache-invalidation.md and /docs/sdk/js/quickstart.md. Also a stale anchor in the runtime guide to the batching section.

ajay: Will rip through `rg "pin_model"` and open a small PR. I'll update both curl and JS examples.

ben: I'll run the local preview and smoke test the examples in the node snippets.

lucy: Happy to quick-review the PR. Ping when ready.

docs-bot: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/578 by ajay — fixes pin_model -> model_id and anchors

ajay: pushed fixes and rebased. Build green on CI now.

deploy-bot: preview published: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/cache-invalidation — build 578 :white_check_mark:

maria: Nice, thanks team. I'll also add a short note to the sprint retro about the breaking rename to help other squads.

ben: FYI I found one more example in an internal gist linked from the runbook — sent a follow-up in that PR.

lucy: Reviewed and LGTM. Merging now.

ajay: Merged. Leaving the thread.
